text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Among the voices rooting for Ines Fujin to win the Satsuki Sho, one resonates in particular. A certain fan is cheering her on because they want to see their dream in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Around this time, Ines Fujin receives some encouragement from her younger sisters—whom she imagines are dancing their hearts out—and her morale gets a huge boost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho arrives. With Ines Fujin's popularity surging, the number of opponents ready to mark her is probably on the rise too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Among those opponents is her friend, Mejiro Ryan. The two burn with a passionate rivalry as the curtains rise on a sparking hot Satsuki Sho!
